rules.applies_when: The claim changes the HTTP API or the web API client
rules.requirement: Change api/openapi.yaml and regenerate the client; leave web/src/api-client.ts to the generator

rules.applies_when: The claim adds or changes a storage method
rules.requirement: Implement the method in both the SQLite and the Postgres store in the same change, and cover it in the shared store tests

rules.applies_when: The claim adds a way for third parties to extend the product
rules.requirement: Keep extensions out of the product; build features directly instead of through a plugin system

rules.applies_when: The claim changes an existing UI page
rules.requirement: Change the existing page incrementally instead of rewriting it from scratch
